independence: Converter uses lxml DjVuXML parsing. Oracle independently parses source and scan data with stdlib ElementTree, traverses actual TEI without converter imports, and checks PDF count with PyMuPDF. Both depend on retained OCR XML as textual witness; visual print fidelity remains outside this mechanical proof.

mapping_policy.harmony: Parallel Gospel passage positions are retained as source page-column order. Cross-column passage/verse alignments are not inferred from OCR.
mapping_policy.layout: PAGECOLUMN/REGION/PARAGRAPH and direct HIDDENTEXT/PARAGRAPH are represented in their source order; LINE and WORD boundaries, coordinates and confidence are retained.
mapping_policy.nonaccess_cards: Scandata leaves 364-367 are nonaccess color/white calibration cards and are excluded from literary TEI, with identities retained in accountability.
mapping_policy.pages: Every accessible scan leaf maps to a page div and a PDF-page milestone whose relative URI resolves from the candidate package to the retained, hash-bound scan. Each leaf without OCR text has a no-transcription gap plus an explicit linked scan figure; leaf 10 is visually identified as a map.
mapping_policy.support: Metadata, receipt, page-number map, provider inventory, scan data, and OCR text are bound as source/support evidence, not silently merged into reading text.
mapping_policy.text: Source WORD text is preserved exactly. A display-space is added only between adjacent WORD nodes lacking terminal whitespace.

review_limitations: OCR is uncorrected against page images. Full visual collation and OCR correction are pending.

Twenty-one accessible leaves contain no OCR words. Their page images are linked in TEI; map leaf 10, bookplate leaf 2, and digitization mark leaf 5 were visually inspected, but their wording and other image-only detail are not transcribed.
TEI retains source layout grouping but does not assert Gospel verse synchronization beyond what source OCR supplies.
